Un bruit se corrige par tolérance ; une convention se reconnaît. L'étendue temporelle est énorme : 1917 à 1989 dans un seul corpus.
seen.excerpt_en: 184 titles in full capitals in a single corpus — "STUDIES ON THE NATURE OF RESISTANCE OF GRAM-NEGATIVE BACILLI TO PENICILLIN". A convention of the period, which breaks any case-sensitive entity recognition. It is not noise (23): it is a period norm, regular and systematic. Noise is corrected by tolerance; a convention is recognised. The time span is huge: 1917 to 1989 in a single corpus.
